name: LetsGo2Travel
subtitle: Plan your trip, explore more
promotionalText: Find your next destination, organise your trips and share travel expenses. Keep country guides, events and travel notes together.
description:
Plan your next journey with LetsGo2Travel. Find travel ideas, organise your plans and keep your memories in one place.

DISCOVER WHERE TO GO
Explore countries and check entry information for your passport country and type. Read country news and travel notices with links to their sources, including the Turkish Ministry of Foreign Affairs and other official authorities. Some source material is available in its original language.

PLAN AND SAVE YOUR ROUTE
Get route suggestions based on your budget, trip length and preferences. Save plans and see whether they have synced to your account. Open route details already saved on your device when you are offline.

KEEP YOUR TRIP ORGANISED
Use Travel Cockpit to keep flight dates, airports and scheduled times together. Manage checklists, vote on shared plans and record group budgets and expenses.

SAVE EVENTS AND MEMORIES
Discover events, save your favourites and set reminders when a start time is available. Add travel journal notes and keep track of the countries you have visited.

LEARN FROM OTHER TRAVELLERS
Ask questions and read experiences in the community. Use the three-dot menu on another user's content to report it or block the author. Manage blocked accounts from your profile.

The interface supports Turkish, English, Albanian and Romanian. Core discovery features are available without signing in. Account synchronisation and community interactions require an account. Loading new information and using shared trip features require an internet connection.

LetsGo2Travel is an information and planning tool. Confirm visa and entry requirements with the relevant authorities before travelling. Flight times are scheduled times; check the airline for current information. Reservations and ticket purchases take place with the provider you open.

Support: hello@letsgo2travel.com.tr
whatsNew: Explore a refreshed collection of 50 cities and more places to visit. Maps, saved places and downloaded areas are now together. Route planning, travel dates and shared trip invitations are easier to use. Community chats and profile layouts have been improved. Albanian and Romanian interface support has been added, alongside simpler travel tools and performance and stability improvements.
